plain_id: Putusan pendamping tentang dapat diterimanya komunikasi, menyangkut keberatan soal upaya hukum domestik dan perkara paralel di ICJ. Perlu dicocokkan dengan teks resmi.

name: Qatar v. United Arab Emirates (ICERD), Preliminary Objections, Judgment of 4 February 2021
plain_en: The Court upheld a preliminary objection and found it lacked jurisdiction, holding that 'national origin' in ICERD does not include current nationality. Reads the convention differently from the CERD Committee's 2019 decision; a central text on how far ICERD protects non-citizens.
plain_id: Mahkamah menerima keberatan awal dan menyatakan tidak berwenang, dengan pertimbangan bahwa 'asal kebangsaan' dalam ICERD tidak mencakup kewarganegaraan saat ini. Tafsir ini berbeda dari putusan Komite CERD 2019.

name: Hammel v. Madagascar
plain_en: Expulsion of a foreign lawyer without a chance to contest the order; the Committee read article 13 ICCPR as requiring that an alien lawfully present may be expelled only by a decision reached in accordance with law.
plain_id: Pengusiran seorang advokat asing tanpa kesempatan menggugat perintah pengusiran; Komite menafsirkan Pasal 13 ICCPR bahwa orang asing yang berada secara sah hanya dapat diusir melalui keputusan yang sesuai hukum.

name: Giry v. Dominican Republic
plain_en: A foreign national was removed without any administrative or judicial process; the Committee treated the removal as expulsion under article 13, whatever its label (extradition or expulsion).
plain_id: Seorang warga asing dipindahkan tanpa proses administratif atau peradilan apa pun; Komite memperlakukannya sebagai pengusiran menurut Pasal 13, apa pun sebutannya.

name: Maksudov, Rakhimov, Tashbaev and Pirmatov v. Kyrgyzstan
plain_en: Extradition of Uzbek asylum seekers despite risk of torture; issues of non-refoulement, diplomatic assurances and detention. Findings to be confirmed against the full text.
plain_id: Ekstradisi pencari suaka asal Uzbekistan meskipun ada risiko penyiksaan; isu non-refoulement, jaminan diplomatik dan penahanan. Temuan perlu dicocokkan dengan teks lengkap.

name: Ilyasov v. Kazakhstan
plain_en: Entry ban on a foreign national that kept him from his family in Kazakhstan; family life (articles 17 and 23). The State later reported that the ban had been lifted. Findings to be confirmed against the full text.
plain_id: Larangan masuk terhadap warga asing yang memisahkannya dari keluarganya di Kazakhstan; hak atas kehidupan keluarga (Pasal 17 dan 23). Negara kemudian melaporkan larangan itu dicabut.

name: Advisory Opinion OC-4/84 (proposed amendments to the naturalization provisions of the Constitution of Costa Rica)
plain_en: Whether stricter naturalization rules for some foreigners, and different rules for foreign wives and husbands, are compatible with equality before the law. The Court accepted some distinctions as reasonable but found the sex-based difference discriminatory.
plain_id: Apakah aturan naturalisasi yang lebih ketat bagi sebagian orang asing, dan aturan yang berbeda bagi istri dan suami asing, sesuai dengan persamaan di depan hukum. Mahkamah menerima sebagian pembedaan sebagai wajar, tetapi menilai pembedaan berdasarkan jenis kelamin diskriminatif.

name: Advisory Opinion OC-27/21 (freedom of association, collective bargaining and the right to strike, with a gender perspective)
citation: OC-27/21, requested by the Inter-American Commission
plain_en: Scope of union freedom, collective bargaining and the right to strike, and their link to equality for women workers. Relevant to migrant workers, who are often excluded from union rights in law or practice. Details to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Cakupan kebebasan berserikat, perundingan bersama dan hak mogok, serta kaitannya dengan kesetaraan bagi pekerja perempuan. Relevan bagi pekerja migran, yang sering dikecualikan dari hak berserikat dalam hukum atau praktik.

name: Advisory Opinion OC-31/25 (content and scope of the right to care)
plain_en: Recognizes care as an autonomous right, covering the right to be cared for, to care and to self-care, and the labor rights of paid care workers. Relevant to migrant domestic and care workers. Date and details to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Mengakui perawatan sebagai hak yang berdiri sendiri, mencakup hak untuk dirawat, merawat, dan merawat diri, serta hak-hak pekerja perawatan berbayar. Relevan bagi pekerja rumah tangga dan pekerja perawatan migran.

name: Advisory Opinion OC-32/25 (climate emergency and human rights)
citation: OC-32/25, requested by Chile and Colombia
plain_en: State duties in the climate emergency, including protection of people displaced or moving because of climate impacts. Date and the passages on human mobility to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Kewajiban negara dalam darurat iklim, termasuk perlindungan bagi orang yang mengungsi atau berpindah akibat dampak iklim.

name: Advisory Opinion on the compatibility of vagrancy laws with the African Charter and other human rights instruments (No. 001/2018)
court: African Court on Human and Peoples’ Rights
citation: Request No. 001/2018, requested by the Pan African Lawyers Union; opinion of 4 December 2020
plain_en: Found that vagrancy laws punishing people for being poor, homeless or without visible means of support, including summary arrest and forced relocation, are incompatible with the African Charter. Such laws often fall on migrants and informal workers. Details to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Menyatakan bahwa undang-undang gelandangan yang menghukum orang karena miskin, tunawisma, atau tanpa mata pencaharian yang jelas, termasuk penangkapan seketika dan pemindahan paksa, bertentangan dengan Piagam Afrika. Aturan semacam ini kerap mengenai migran dan pekerja informal.

name: Obligations of States in respect of Climate Change (Advisory Opinion)
citation: Advisory Opinion of 23 July 2025, requested by the UN General Assembly (GL No. 187)
plain_en: States’ obligations under international law to protect the climate system, read together with human rights law. Included for its relevance to climate-related displacement and migration; the relevant passages are to be confirmed against the text.
plain_id: Kewajiban negara menurut hukum internasional untuk melindungi sistem iklim, dibaca bersama hukum HAM. Dimasukkan karena relevan dengan pengungsian dan migrasi terkait iklim.

name: The Haitian Centre for Human Rights et al. v. United States
plain_en: Interdiction of Haitian boats on the high seas and summary return of the people on board to Haiti. The Commission found that the American Declaration applied to conduct at sea and that the returns breached the rights to life, liberty and security, equality, asylum and judicial protection. Key text on extraterritorial obligations and non-refoulement at sea; compare Hirsi Jamaa v. Italy (ECtHR 2012). Details to be confirmed against the report.
plain_id: Pencegatan kapal warga Haiti di laut lepas dan pemulangan seketika penumpangnya ke Haiti. Komisi menyatakan bahwa Deklarasi Amerika berlaku atas tindakan di laut dan bahwa pemulangan itu melanggar hak atas hidup, kebebasan dan keamanan, persamaan, suaka, serta perlindungan hukum. Bandingkan dengan Hirsi Jamaa v. Italia (ECtHR 2012).

name: Asylum Case (Colombia v. Peru), Judgment of 20 November 1950
plain_en: Colombia granted diplomatic asylum in its Lima embassy to the Peruvian politician Victor Raúl Haya de la Torre. The Court held that Colombia could not unilaterally qualify the offence as political in a way binding on Peru, that Peru was not obliged to give safe conduct out of the country, and that the asylum did not meet the urgency requirement of the 1928 Havana Convention. Also a leading case on proving a regional custom (Latin American practice of asylum).
plain_id: Kolombia memberikan suaka diplomatik di kedutaannya di Lima kepada politisi Peru Victor Raúl Haya de la Torre. Mahkamah memutuskan bahwa Kolombia tidak dapat secara sepihak menetapkan sifat politis kejahatan itu secara mengikat bagi Peru, bahwa Peru tidak wajib memberi jaminan jalan keluar, dan bahwa suaka itu tidak memenuhi syarat keadaan mendesak dalam Konvensi Havana 1928. Juga perkara penting tentang pembuktian kebiasaan regional.

name: Haya de la Torre Case (Colombia v. Peru), Judgment of 13 June 1951
plain_en: Follow-up to the Asylum Case. The Court held that Colombia was not obliged to surrender Haya de la Torre to the Peruvian authorities, but that the asylum, granted irregularly, should be brought to an end; it left the way of ending it to the parties. Shows the limits of judicial settlement in asylum disputes.
plain_id: Lanjutan Perkara Suaka. Mahkamah memutuskan bahwa Kolombia tidak wajib menyerahkan Haya de la Torre kepada otoritas Peru, tetapi suaka yang diberikan tidak sesuai aturan itu harus diakhiri; cara mengakhirinya diserahkan kepada para pihak.

name: Nottebohm Case (Liechtenstein v. Guatemala), Second Phase, Judgment of 6 April 1955
plain_en: A German-born merchant who had lived in Guatemala for decades acquired Liechtenstein nationality shortly before being interned and expelled by Guatemala during the Second World War. The Court held the claim inadmissible: Guatemala need not recognize a nationality without a genuine connection, so Liechtenstein could not exercise diplomatic protection. Leading case on nationality and the protection of long-term foreign residents.
plain_id: Seorang pedagang kelahiran Jerman yang puluhan tahun tinggal di Guatemala memperoleh kewarganegaraan Liechtenstein tak lama sebelum diinternir dan diusir oleh Guatemala pada Perang Dunia II. Mahkamah menyatakan gugatan tidak dapat diterima: Guatemala tidak wajib mengakui kewarganegaraan tanpa hubungan yang sungguh-sungguh, sehingga Liechtenstein tidak dapat memberikan perlindungan diplomatik.

name: Nationality Decrees Issued in Tunis and Morocco (Advisory Opinion)
plain_en: Dispute between France and the United Kingdom over French decrees conferring nationality on persons born in the protectorates of Tunis and Morocco, including children of British subjects. The Court held that the matter was not solely within French domestic jurisdiction, because whether a question is domestic depends on the development of international relations and on treaty obligations. Foundational text on the limits of state discretion over nationality.
plain_id: Sengketa antara Prancis dan Inggris tentang dekrit Prancis yang memberikan kewarganegaraan kepada orang yang lahir di protektorat Tunis dan Maroko, termasuk anak-anak warga Inggris. Mahkamah menyatakan bahwa persoalan itu bukan semata urusan dalam negeri Prancis, karena hal itu bergantung pada perkembangan hubungan internasional dan kewajiban perjanjian.

name: Case C-34/09 Gerardo Ruiz Zambrano v Office national de l’emploi
court: Court of Justice of the European Union
plain_en: Colombian parents of Belgian citizen children were refused residence and a work permit. The Court held that EU citizenship precludes measures that deprive citizen children of the genuine enjoyment of their rights, so the parents had to be allowed to reside and work. Comparator.
plain_id: Orang tua asal Kolombia dari anak-anak berkewarganegaraan Belgia ditolak izin tinggal dan izin kerjanya. Mahkamah menyatakan bahwa kewarganegaraan Uni Eropa melarang tindakan yang menghilangkan penikmatan hak anak-anak warga negara, sehingga orang tua harus diizinkan tinggal dan bekerja. Pembanding.

name: Kleindienst v. Mandel
court: Supreme Court of the United States
plain_en: A Belgian Marxist scholar was refused a visa to speak in the United States. The Court upheld the refusal, holding that courts will not look behind a facially legitimate and bona fide reason given by the executive for excluding a non-citizen. Comparator on judicial deference in admission decisions.
plain_id: Seorang akademisi Marxis asal Belgia ditolak visanya untuk berceramah di Amerika Serikat. Mahkamah menguatkan penolakan itu: pengadilan tidak akan menguji lebih jauh alasan eksekutif yang secara lahiriah sah dan beritikad baik untuk menolak orang asing. Pembanding.

name: Aristimuño Mendizabal v. France
plain_en: A Spanish national lawfully living in France was kept for some fourteen years on short temporary residence receipts. The Court found that the prolonged insecurity of her status breached her right to private and family life (Art. 8). Comparator on precarious residence.
plain_id: Seorang warga Spanyol yang tinggal secara sah di Prancis selama sekitar empat belas tahun hanya diberi tanda terima izin tinggal sementara berjangka pendek. Mahkamah menilai ketidakpastian status yang berkepanjangan itu melanggar hak atas kehidupan pribadi dan keluarga (Pasal 8). Pembanding.

name: M.K. and Others v. Poland
plain_en: Chechen families were repeatedly turned away at the Polish–Belarusian border without their asylum claims being received. The Court found breaches of the prohibition of ill-treatment and refoulement (Art. 3), of collective expulsion (Protocol 4, Art. 4) and of the duty to comply with interim measures. Comparator on access to asylum at land borders.
plain_id: Keluarga-keluarga Chechnya berulang kali ditolak di perbatasan Polandia–Belarus tanpa permohonan suaka mereka diterima. Mahkamah menyatakan pelanggaran larangan perlakuan buruk dan refoulement (Pasal 3), larangan pengusiran kolektif (Protokol 4 Pasal 4), dan kewajiban mematuhi tindakan sementara. Pembanding.

name: M.N. and Others v. Belgium (Grand Chamber decision)
plain_en: A Syrian family applied for humanitarian visas at the Belgian embassy in Beirut. The Grand Chamber held that the visa procedure did not bring them within Belgium’s jurisdiction, so the Convention did not apply and the application was inadmissible. Comparator on the limits of extraterritorial obligations in admission.
plain_id: Sebuah keluarga Suriah mengajukan visa kemanusiaan di Kedutaan Belgia di Beirut. Majelis Agung menyatakan bahwa prosedur visa itu tidak membawa mereka ke dalam yurisdiksi Belgia, sehingga Konvensi tidak berlaku dan permohonan tidak dapat diterima. Pembanding.

name: Khan v. France
plain_en: An unaccompanied Afghan child lived for months in the Calais camp without the protective care ordered by a French judge. The Court found degrading treatment (Art. 3) because the authorities failed to provide care. Comparator on unaccompanied migrant children.
plain_id: Seorang anak Afghanistan tanpa pendamping tinggal berbulan-bulan di kamp Calais tanpa pengasuhan yang diperintahkan hakim Prancis. Mahkamah menyatakan terjadi perlakuan merendahkan martabat (Pasal 3) karena otoritas gagal memberikan pengasuhan. Pembanding.

name: Aumeeruddy-Cziffra and 19 other Mauritian women v. Mauritius
plain_en: Mauritian laws let foreign wives of Mauritian men reside freely but made foreign husbands of Mauritian women subject to residence permits and deportation. The Committee found sex discrimination in the protection of the family (articles 2(1), 3, 17, 23 and 26 ICCPR). Early leading view on family life and residence of non-citizen spouses.
plain_id: Undang-undang Mauritius membolehkan istri asing warga Mauritius tinggal bebas, tetapi suami asing perempuan Mauritius harus memiliki izin tinggal dan dapat dideportasi. Komite menyatakan adanya diskriminasi jenis kelamin dalam perlindungan keluarga (Pasal 2(1), 3, 17, 23 dan 26 ICCPR).

name: Núñez Chipana v. Venezuela
plain_en: Venezuela extradited a Peruvian woman to Peru despite a substantial risk of torture, and despite the Committee's request for interim measures. The Committee found a breach of the non-refoulement obligation in article 3 CAT.
plain_id: Venezuela mengekstradisi seorang perempuan Peru ke Peru meskipun ada risiko nyata penyiksaan dan permintaan tindakan sementara dari Komite. Komite menyatakan pelanggaran kewajiban non-refoulement dalam Pasal 3 CAT.

name: Pelit v. Azerbaijan
plain_en: A Turkish national of Kurdish origin, recognized as a refugee in Germany, was extradited from Azerbaijan to Turkey in spite of the Committee's request for interim measures. The Committee found breaches of articles 3 and 22 CAT; diplomatic assurances did not cure the risk.
plain_id: Seorang warga Turki keturunan Kurdi yang diakui sebagai pengungsi di Jerman diekstradisi dari Azerbaijan ke Turki meskipun Komite telah meminta tindakan sementara. Komite menyatakan pelanggaran Pasal 3 dan 22 CAT; jaminan diplomatik tidak menghapus risiko.

name: Abdussamatov and Others v. Kazakhstan
plain_en: Twenty-nine Uzbek asylum seekers were extradited from Kazakhstan to Uzbekistan. The Committee found breaches of articles 3 and 22 CAT and held that an examination under the Refugee Convention alone did not satisfy the absolute non-refoulement obligation under CAT.
plain_id: Dua puluh sembilan pencari suaka asal Uzbekistan diekstradisi dari Kazakhstan ke Uzbekistan. Komite menyatakan pelanggaran Pasal 3 dan 22 CAT dan bahwa pemeriksaan menurut Konvensi Pengungsi saja tidak memenuhi kewajiban non-refoulement yang mutlak menurut CAT.

name: Raghda Habal and son v. Argentina
plain_en: A Syrian-born woman was summarily expelled from Argentina after her naturalization was annulled. The Commission held that due process guarantees (American Convention arts. 8 and 25) apply to expulsion proceedings, and found violations. Details to be confirmed against the report.
plain_id: Seorang perempuan kelahiran Suriah diusir secara seketika dari Argentina setelah naturalisasinya dibatalkan. Komisi menyatakan bahwa jaminan proses hukum (Pasal 8 dan 25 Konvensi Amerika) berlaku dalam proses pengusiran, dan menemukan pelanggaran.

name: Loren Laroye Riebe Star, Jorge Barón Guttlein and Rodolfo Izal Elorz v. Mexico
plain_en: Three foreign priests working in Chiapas were detained and expelled in 1995 without a chance to defend themselves. The Commission held that a minimum of due process applies to expulsion and found violations of the rights to personal liberty, fair trial and judicial protection.
plain_id: Tiga pastor asing yang bekerja di Chiapas ditahan dan diusir pada 1995 tanpa kesempatan membela diri. Komisi menyatakan bahwa proses hukum minimum berlaku dalam pengusiran dan menemukan pelanggaran hak atas kebebasan, peradilan yang adil dan perlindungan hukum.

name: John Doe et al. v. Canada
plain_en: Asylum seekers arriving from the United States were 'directed back' there to wait for their hearings and some were then removed by the United States. The Commission held that a state may not return a claimant to a third country whose law bars their asylum claim without an individual assessment. Comparator (North America).
plain_id: Pencari suaka yang datang dari Amerika Serikat 'dikembalikan' ke sana untuk menunggu sidang, dan sebagian kemudian dipulangkan oleh AS. Komisi menyatakan negara tidak boleh mengembalikan pemohon ke negara ketiga yang hukumnya menghalangi permohonan suakanya tanpa penilaian individual. Pembanding.

name: Rafael Ferrer-Mazorra et al. v. United States
plain_en: Cuban nationals who arrived in the 1980 Mariel boatlift were held for years in immigration detention. The Commission found violations of the rights to liberty and to protection from arbitrary arrest under the American Declaration. Comparator on prolonged immigration detention.
plain_id: Warga Kuba yang tiba lewat eksodus perahu Mariel 1980 ditahan bertahun-tahun dalam penahanan imigrasi. Komisi menyatakan pelanggaran hak atas kebebasan dan perlindungan dari penangkapan sewenang-wenang menurut Deklarasi Amerika. Pembanding.

name: Jaga v. Donges and Another; Bhana v. Donges and Another
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Validity of immigration restrictions applied to Indian residents of South Africa (historical Immigration Act case).
plain_id: Keabsahan pembatasan imigrasi terhadap penduduk keturunan India di Afrika Selatan (perkara UU Imigrasi lama).

name: K E v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Immigration Act matter involving a foreign national and the Minister of Home Affairs.
plain_id: Perkara UU Imigrasi antara seorang warga asing dan Menteri Dalam Negeri.

name: Buthelezi and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Immigration-related claim against the Minister of Home Affairs under the Immigration Act.
plain_id: Gugatan terkait imigrasi terhadap Menteri Dalam Negeri berdasarkan UU Imigrasi.

name: Minister of Home Affairs v. A R
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Whether a foreign national who did not apply for asylum on arrival can later access the asylum system.
plain_id: Apakah warga asing yang tidak mengajukan suaka saat tiba masih bisa masuk sistem suaka kemudian.

name: Director-General, Department of Home Affairs and Others v. A I and Another
plain_en: Constitutional challenge to Refugees Act amendments on abandonment of asylum applications.
plain_id: Uji konstitusional atas perubahan UU Pengungsi tentang permohonan suaka yang dianggap ditinggalkan.

name: A I and Another v. Director of Asylum Seeker Management: Department of Home Affairs and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Refugees Act provisions treating asylum applications as abandoned when permits lapse.
plain_id: Ketentuan UU Pengungsi yang menganggap permohonan suaka ditinggalkan bila izinnya kedaluwarsa.

name: L K v. Chairperson Standing Committee for Refugee Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa KwaZulu-Natal, Durban
plain_en: Review of a refugee status decision by the Standing Committee for Refugee Affairs.
plain_id: Peninjauan keputusan status pengungsi oleh Komite Tetap Urusan Pengungsi.

name: Director-General: The Department of Home Affairs and Others v. Dekoba
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Refugee reception office access and the time an asylum seeker has to report after entry.
plain_id: Akses ke kantor penerimaan pengungsi dan batas waktu pencari suaka melapor setelah masuk.

name: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Somali Association of South Africa Eastern Cape
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Closure of the Port Elizabeth refugee reception office and its effect on asylum seekers.
plain_id: Penutupan kantor penerimaan pengungsi Port Elizabeth dan dampaknya bagi pencari suaka.

name: Asanbeng v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa South Gauteng, Johannesburg
plain_en: Immigration Act matter concerning a foreign national and the Minister of Home Affairs.
plain_id: Perkara UU Imigrasi tentang seorang warga asing dan Menteri Dalam Negeri.

name: Scalabrini Centre of Cape Town and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
plain_en: Scalabrini Centre litigation against the Minister of Home Affairs concerning asylum seekers.
plain_id: Gugatan Scalabrini Centre terhadap Menteri Dalam Negeri mengenai pencari suaka.

name: Scalabrini Centre of Cape Town and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
plain_en: Challenge to Home Affairs regulations affecting asylum seekers (Scalabrini Centre).
plain_id: Gugatan atas peraturan Kementerian Dalam Negeri yang berdampak pada pencari suaka (Scalabrini Centre).

name: Road Accident Fund v. Mudawo and Others; Road Accident Fund v. Lyton and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Road Accident Fund claims brought by foreign nationals.
plain_id: Klaim Dana Kecelakaan Lalu Lintas yang diajukan warga asing.

name: Booysen and Others v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Work permits and residence rights of foreign spouses of South African citizens.
plain_id: Izin kerja dan hak tinggal pasangan asing warga negara Afrika Selatan.

name: Tsebe and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
court: High Court of South Africa South Gauteng, Johannesburg
plain_en: Extradition or deportation of a Botswana national facing the death penalty.
plain_id: Ekstradisi atau deportasi warga Botswana yang terancam hukuman mati.

name: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Tsebe and Others, Minister of Justice and Constitutional Development and Another v. Tsebe and Others
plain_en: Deportation or extradition of foreign nationals to a state where they face the death penalty.
plain_id: Deportasi atau ekstradisi warga asing ke negara tempat mereka terancam hukuman mati.

name: Helen Suzman Foundation and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another (All Truck Drivers Forum intervening)
court: High Court of South Africa North Gauteng, Pretoria
plain_en: Termination of the Zimbabwean Exemption Permit program.
plain_id: Penghentian program Zimbabwean Exemption Permit.

name: City of Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality v. Unknown Protesters/Refugees and Others
court: High Court of South Africa North Gauteng, Pretoria
plain_en: Eviction application against refugees and protesters camping in Pretoria.
plain_id: Permohonan pengusiran pengungsi dan pengunjuk rasa yang berkemah di Pretoria.

name: H H v. Chairperson of Refugee Appeal Board and Others
court: High Court of South Africa Western Cape, Cape Town
plain_en: Review of a Refugee Appeal Board decision on an asylum claim.
plain_id: Peninjauan keputusan Dewan Banding Pengungsi atas permohonan suaka.

name: Ulde v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Lawfulness of detention at Lindela repatriation centre beyond the period allowed by the Immigration Act.
plain_id: Keabsahan penahanan di pusat repatriasi Lindela melebihi jangka waktu menurut UU Imigrasi.

name: Malachi v. Cape Dance Academy International (Pty) Ltd and Others
plain_en: Imprisonment of a Malawian employee for debt on suspicion of flight (arrest to found jurisdiction).
plain_id: Pemenjaraan pekerja asal Malawi karena utang atas dugaan akan kabur (penangkapan untuk menetapkan yurisdiksi).

name: S v. Qurashi and Others
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Criminal appeal in a human trafficking prosecution concerning exploitation of trafficked persons.
plain_id: Banding pidana dalam penuntutan perdagangan orang atas eksploitasi korban.

name: Centre for Child Law v. Director General Department of Home Affairs and Others
plain_en: Birth registration of children born in South Africa to foreign parents.
plain_id: Pencatatan kelahiran anak yang lahir di Afrika Selatan dari orang tua asing.

name: Scalabrini Centre of Cape Town and Another v. Minister of Home Affairs and Others
plain_en: Constitutional challenge by Scalabrini Centre concerning Home Affairs rules affecting asylum seekers and migrants.
plain_id: Uji konstitusional oleh Scalabrini Centre atas aturan Kementerian Dalam Negeri yang berdampak pada pencari suaka dan migran.

name: Mulowayi and Others v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Citizenship claim by a person born in South Africa to foreign parents under the Citizenship Act.
plain_id: Klaim kewarganegaraan orang yang lahir di Afrika Selatan dari orang tua asing berdasarkan UU Kewarganegaraan.

name: Democratic Alliance v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Automatic loss of South African citizenship on acquiring another nationality (section 6(1)(a) Citizenship Act).
plain_id: Hilangnya kewarganegaraan Afrika Selatan secara otomatis saat memperoleh kewarganegaraan lain (pasal 6(1)(a) UU Kewarganegaraan).

name: Minister of Home Affairs and Others v. Jose and Another
court: Supreme Court of Appeal of South Africa
plain_en: Citizenship by birth for children born in South Africa to non-citizen parents.
plain_id: Kewarganegaraan berdasarkan kelahiran bagi anak yang lahir di Afrika Selatan dari orang tua bukan warga negara.

name: Chisuse and Others v. Director-General, Department of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Citizenship by descent for persons born abroad to a South African parent.
plain_id: Kewarganegaraan berdasarkan keturunan bagi orang yang lahir di luar negeri dari orang tua warga Afrika Selatan.

name: Lawyers for Human Rights v. Minister of Home Affairs and Another

name: Decision 028-029/PUU-IV/2006 (minimum age of 21 for work with private employers abroad)
holding: Rejected (5 to 4). The age limit in Art. 35(a) of Law 39/2004 pursues a legitimate aim, the personal and emotional maturity needed for work in private homes, is objectively and reasonably justified and is not discriminatory.
plain_en: Women aged 18 to 20 were refused departure because they were under 21, the minimum age for working in a private household abroad. They asked the Constitutional Court to strike the rule down. A narrow majority refused: the Court said the age limit protects workers and does not stop anyone from working.
plain_id: Sejumlah perempuan berusia 18 sampai 20 tahun ditolak berangkat karena belum berusia 21 tahun, batas usia minimum untuk bekerja pada pengguna perseorangan di luar negeri. Mereka meminta Mahkamah Konstitusi membatalkan ketentuan tersebut. Mayoritas tipis hakim menolak: menurut Mahkamah, batas usia tersebut melindungi pekerja dan tidak menghalangi hak seseorang untuk bekerja.

name: Decision 5/PUU-XI/2013 (challenge to Law 39/2004, Art. 60, by a former worker's brother)
holding: Not accepted. The petitioner gave no proof that he was the guardian of the worker concerned, so he lacked legal standing.
plain_en: A man asked the Court to review a rule of the 2004 migrant worker law on behalf of his sister, a former migrant worker. The Court did not look at the rule itself, because he could not show he had the right to act for her.
plain_id: Seorang laki-laki meminta Mahkamah menguji salah satu ketentuan UU 39/2004 atas nama saudara perempuannya, seorang mantan TKI. Mahkamah tidak memeriksa pokok perkara karena Pemohon tidak dapat membuktikan bahwa ia berhak bertindak atas nama saudaranya.

name: Decision 50/PUU-XI/2013 (renewing a contract without first going home)
holding: Granted in part. Art. 59 was struck down: it removed or threatened the worker's chance to extend a contract with an employer of the worker's choice, breaching equal treatment and the right to work and a decent living. The other challenged articles (Arts. 10(b), 58(2), 60) were upheld; who may place workers abroad is a matter of legislative policy.
plain_en: Women domestic workers from Cianjur challenged a rule forcing workers with household employers to come home before they could renew their contract. The Court struck the rule down: a protection law should not take away a worker's chance to stay with an employer she wants to keep working for.
plain_id: Para pekerja rumah tangga migran perempuan dari Cianjur menguji ketentuan yang mewajibkan TKI pada pengguna perseorangan pulang terlebih dahulu sebelum memperpanjang perjanjian kerja. Mahkamah membatalkan ketentuan tersebut: undang-undang perlindungan tidak boleh menghilangkan kesempatan pekerja untuk tetap bekerja pada majikan yang dikehendakinya.

name: Decision 61/PUU-XIII/2015 (placement rules behind the Middle East moratorium)
holding: Rejected. Different treatment serves to uphold citizens' rights to work and a decent living rather than to discriminate; requiring employers to be legal entities makes them easier to hold liable; the placement agency BNP2TKI is an open legal policy choice of the legislature.
plain_en: A placement company, a former worker in Riyadh and a woman who could not leave because of the halt on placements to the Middle East challenged the rules behind it. The Court upheld them, saying the rules aim to protect workers.
plain_id: Sebuah perusahaan penempatan, seorang mantan TKI di Riyadh, dan seorang calon TKI yang tidak dapat berangkat karena penghentian penempatan ke Timur Tengah menguji ketentuan yang menjadi dasarnya. Mahkamah menolak permohonan tersebut karena ketentuan itu bertujuan melindungi pekerja.

name: Decision 6/PUU-XIII/2015 (overseas worker card (KTKLN) for seafarers)
holding: Rejected. The KTKLN is a form of state protection at every stage of placement abroad: before, during and after placement.
plain_en: Six seafarers argued that the card required of workers going abroad was a burden that did not fit their work. The Court disagreed: the card is one of the ways the state protects workers before, during and after work abroad.
plain_id: Enam orang pelaut berpendapat bahwa kartu yang diwajibkan bagi TKI merupakan beban yang tidak sesuai dengan pekerjaan mereka. Mahkamah tidak sependapat: kartu tersebut merupakan salah satu bentuk perlindungan negara sebelum, selama, dan sesudah bekerja di luar negeri.

name: Decision 12/PUU-XIV/2016 (settling disputes between workers and placement companies)
holding: Rejected. Leaving a remedy out of Art. 85(2) does not make it unconstitutional; if workers do not get access to justice, that is a problem of implementation, not of the norm.
plain_en: The head of a union of Indonesian overseas workers said the law's dispute rules left workers without a way to court against their placement company. The Court said the rule itself is valid and that any failure lies in how it is applied.
plain_id: Ketua serikat pekerja Indonesia luar negeri berpendapat bahwa ketentuan penyelesaian perselisihan dalam undang-undang membuat pekerja tidak memiliki jalan ke pengadilan untuk menggugat perusahaan penempatan. Mahkamah menyatakan ketentuan tersebut sah dan bahwa kekurangannya terletak pada pelaksanaannya.

name: Decision 32/PUU-XV/2017 (meaning of 'exploitation' in the trafficking law)
holding: Rejected. Art. 2(1) defines a formal offence, clear on its face; the petitioner's case concerns the application of the law and proof, not its constitutionality.
plain_en: A man prosecuted under the anti-trafficking law argued that it was unfair to convict without proof of actual exploitation. The Court said the law is clear: the crime is complete when the acts are done for the purpose of exploitation, and his complaint was about the evidence in his own case.
plain_id: Seorang laki-laki yang dituntut berdasarkan UU TPPO berpendapat bahwa tidak adil menghukum seseorang tanpa bukti eksploitasi yang nyata. Mahkamah menyatakan undang-undang tersebut jelas: tindak pidana telah selesai ketika perbuatan dilakukan dengan tujuan eksploitasi, dan keberatan Pemohon menyangkut pembuktian dalam perkaranya sendiri.

name: Decision 83/PUU-XVII/2019 (capital and deposit rules for placement companies)
holding: Rejected (5 to 4). Raising the capital and deposit is part of ensuring the qualifications and credibility of placement companies; the criminal provisions apply to anyone who breaches the rules.
plain_en: The association of placement companies said the high capital and deposit rules of the 2017 law shut small agencies out. A narrow majority upheld the rules, which help make sure agencies can answer for what happens to the workers they send.
plain_id: Asosiasi perusahaan penempatan berpendapat bahwa kewajiban modal dan deposito yang tinggi dalam UU 18/2017 menyingkirkan perusahaan kecil. Mayoritas tipis hakim mempertahankan ketentuan tersebut, yang membantu memastikan perusahaan penempatan dapat bertanggung jawab atas pekerja yang dikirimnya.

name: Decision 20/PUU-XVIII/2020 (bank deposit required of placement companies)
holding: Rejected as to Art. 54(1)(b), following decision 83/PUU-XVII/2019; not accepted as to Art. 5(d), which sets duties of migrant workers, not of companies, so the company directors lacked standing.
plain_en: Directors of two placement companies challenged the bank deposit rule. The Court kept it, as it had in a decision the same day.
plain_id: Direktur dua perusahaan penempatan menguji ketentuan deposito di bank. Mahkamah mempertahankannya, sebagaimana dalam putusan yang diucapkan pada hari yang sama.

name: Decision 40/PUU-IX/2011 (exit ban during a preliminary investigation)
holding: Granted. The words 'penyelidikan dan' were struck down: refusing exit when a person is not yet even a suspect can easily be used to block travel abroad and breaches legal certainty and equal treatment (Art. 28D(1)).
plain_en: Six advocates challenged the power to stop people leaving the country before they are even suspects. The Court agreed and removed it, so a ban on leaving now needs at least a formal criminal investigation.
plain_id: Enam advokat menguji kewenangan mencegah orang keluar negeri sebelum ia ditetapkan sebagai tersangka. Mahkamah mengabulkan permohonan tersebut sehingga pencegahan ke luar negeri kini sekurang-kurangnya memerlukan tahap penyidikan.

name: Decision 64/PUU-IX/2011 (repeated extension of exit bans)
holding: Granted in part. The phrase 'setiap kali' (each time) is unconstitutional; extensions are acceptable only if limited and based on justice and legal certainty.
plain_en: A law professor under a travel ban challenged the rule that let the ban be renewed again and again. The Court removed the words 'each time', so renewals now have a limit.
plain_id: Seorang guru besar yang dicegah ke luar negeri menguji ketentuan yang memungkinkan pencegahan diperpanjang berkali-kali. Mahkamah membatalkan frasa “setiap kali” sehingga perpanjangan kini dibatasi.

name: Ma Thida v. Union of Myanmar (overseas employment charge or trafficking charge)
citation: Criminal Revision No. 82(b) of 2020 and No. 1(ka) of 2020, Myanmar Law Reports (Rulings) 2021, pp. 50-53
plain_en: The High Court ordered a recruitment case to be re-charged under the anti-trafficking law, which carries heavier penalties. On revision, the Supreme Court held that a charge properly framed by the trial court should not be set aside just to frame a heavier one. Read from the Burmese report; to be confirmed by a Burmese reader.
plain_id: Pengadilan Tinggi memerintahkan agar perkara perekrutan didakwa ulang berdasarkan undang-undang anti perdagangan orang yang ancaman pidananya lebih berat. Dalam pemeriksaan revisi, Mahkamah Agung menyatakan bahwa dakwaan yang telah disusun dengan benar oleh pengadilan tingkat pertama tidak boleh dikesampingkan hanya untuk menyusun dakwaan yang lebih berat. Dibaca dari laporan berbahasa Myanmar; perlu dikonfirmasi oleh pembaca bahasa Myanmar.

name: State v Murti
plain_en: Sentence for trafficking in persons and seven counts of obtaining property by deception; the court notes this is Fiji's first trafficking conviction.
plain_id: Hukuman atas perdagangan orang dan tujuh dakwaan memperoleh harta dengan tipu daya; pengadilan mencatat ini vonis perdagangan orang pertama di Fiji.

name: State v Laojindamanee (judgment)
plain_en: Aggravated trafficking charges (Crimes Decree 2009 ss 112(5), 113) over three young Thai women brought to Fiji to work.
plain_id: Dakwaan perdagangan orang dengan pemberatan (Dekret Pidana 2009 Pasal 112(5) dan 113) atas tiga perempuan muda Thailand yang dibawa ke Fiji untuk bekerja.

name: State v Laojindamanee (sentence)
plain_en: Sentence for trafficking in persons: three Thai women arrived at Nadi in September 2012 to work in massage parlours.
plain_id: Hukuman atas perdagangan orang: tiga perempuan Thailand tiba di Nadi pada September 2012 untuk bekerja di panti pijat.

name: Laojindamanee v State
plain_en: Appeal against trafficking conviction: two young women from Thailand recruited to work as masseuses in Fiji.
plain_id: Banding atas vonis perdagangan orang: dua perempuan muda dari Thailand direkrut untuk bekerja sebagai terapis pijat di Fiji.

name: State v Reddy
plain_en: Trial judgment on a charge of trafficking in persons contrary to s 112(3) Crimes Act 2009 (offence between January and March 2015, Nadi).
plain_id: Putusan tingkat pertama atas dakwaan perdagangan orang berdasarkan Pasal 112(3) Undang-Undang Pidana 2009 (perbuatan antara Januari dan Maret 2015, di Nadi).

name: State v Marama
plain_en: Trial judgment on one count of trafficking in persons contrary to s 112(4) Crimes Act 2009.
plain_id: Putusan tingkat pertama atas satu dakwaan perdagangan orang berdasarkan Pasal 112(4) Undang-Undang Pidana 2009.

name: Afolayan v Director of Immigration
plain_en: Judicial review of an Immigration Department decision to deport a foreign national living in Fiji.
plain_id: Uji yudisial atas keputusan Departemen Imigrasi untuk mendeportasi warga negara asing yang tinggal di Fiji.

name: State v Minister for Immigration, ex parte Sanjeet
plain_en: Judicial review of a September 2018 decision of the Minister for Immigration (prohibited immigrant / removal).
plain_id: Uji yudisial atas keputusan Menteri Imigrasi bulan September 2018 (penetapan sebagai imigran terlarang dan pengusiran).

name: Swamy v Permanent Secretary for Immigration
plain_en: Leave for judicial review refused: a university Vice-Chancellor on an employment-linked work and residence permit was declared a prohibited immigrant while abroad.
plain_id: Izin uji yudisial ditolak: seorang rektor universitas dengan izin kerja dan izin tinggal yang terkait pekerjaannya ditetapkan sebagai imigran terlarang ketika sedang di luar negeri.

name: Krishnaswamy v The Permanent Secretary for Immigration
plain_en: Appeal from refusal of leave for judicial review of the cancellation of a work permit and a prohibited-immigrant declaration (Immigration Act 2003 s 13(2)(g)).
plain_id: Banding atas penolakan izin uji yudisial terhadap pencabutan izin kerja dan penetapan sebagai imigran terlarang (Undang-Undang Imigrasi 2003 Pasal 13(2)(g)).

name: Director of Immigration v Sung Jin Lee
plain_en: Supreme Court on judicial review of declarations that foreign nationals were prohibited immigrants under s 13(2)(g) Immigration Act 2003 (after Interpol Red Notices).
plain_id: Mahkamah Agung Fiji tentang uji yudisial atas penetapan warga negara asing sebagai imigran terlarang berdasarkan Pasal 13(2)(g) Undang-Undang Imigrasi 2003 (setelah Red Notice Interpol).

name: Sung Jin Lee v The Minister for Home Affairs & Immigration
plain_en: High Court judicial review of prohibited-immigrant declarations (Immigration Act, Citizenship of Fiji Act).
plain_id: Uji yudisial di High Court atas penetapan sebagai imigran terlarang (Undang-Undang Imigrasi dan Undang-Undang Kewarganegaraan Fiji).

name: Public Prosecutor v Somon
plain_en: Sentence of several defendants found guilty of trafficking-related charges (Chief Justice Lunabek).
plain_id: Hukuman bagi beberapa terdakwa yang dinyatakan bersalah atas dakwaan terkait perdagangan orang (Ketua Mahkamah Agung Lunabek).

name: Soapi and Others v Pick Hawkes Bay Inc
court: Employment Court of New Zealand (full Court)
plain_en: Deductions from RSE workers' wages for accommodation and other costs breached the Wages Protection Act 1983 and Minimum Wage Act 1983; arrears ordered.
plain_id: Potongan upah pekerja musiman RSE untuk biaya penginapan dan biaya lain melanggar Undang-Undang Perlindungan Upah 1983 dan Undang-Undang Upah Minimum 1983; kekurangan upah wajib dibayar.

name: Soapi v Pick Hawkes Bay Inc (interlocutory)
plain_en: Interlocutory judgment in the RSE deductions case (the Court agreed to hear the matter directly).
plain_id: Putusan sela dalam perkara potongan upah pekerja RSE (pengadilan setuju memeriksa perkara itu secara langsung).

name: Fair Work Ombudsman v McCrystal Agricultural Services Pty Ltd
court: Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia (Division 2)
citation: Fair Work Ombudsman v McCrystal Agricultural Services Pty Ltd (citation to be added)
plain_en: Penalties ($43,000 company, $5,500 director) for fining PALM workers under an alcohol policy and other unlawful deductions (Fair Work Act).
plain_id: Denda (43.000 dolar untuk perusahaan, 5.500 dolar untuk direktur) karena mendenda pekerja PALM berdasarkan aturan alkohol dan potongan upah lain yang melanggar hukum (Fair Work Act).

name: Fair Work Ombudsman v NQ Powertrain (labour hire)
court: Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia
citation: Fair Work Ombudsman v NQ Powertrain (labour hire) (citation to be added)
plain_en: Court-ordered penalty of about $106,000 against a labour-hire company that underpaid 87 visa holders engaged under the Pacific Labour Scheme and Seasonal Worker Programme.
plain_id: Pengadilan menjatuhkan denda sekitar 106.000 dolar kepada perusahaan penyalur tenaga kerja yang kurang membayar 87 pemegang visa dalam Pacific Labour Scheme dan Seasonal Worker Programme.

name: Fair Work Ombudsman v Maroochy Sunshine Pty Ltd
citation: Fair Work Ombudsman v Maroochy Sunshine Pty Ltd (citation to be added)
plain_en: Penalties against a Queensland labour-hire operator for 'appalling' treatment of 22 Vanuatu workers under the Seasonal Worker Programme (underpaid $77,649).
plain_id: Denda bagi penyalur tenaga kerja di Queensland karena perlakuan yang “sangat buruk” terhadap 22 pekerja Vanuatu dalam Seasonal Worker Programme (kurang bayar 77.649 dolar).

name: JGB and Associates v. NLRC
plain_en: Architect dismissed in Saudi Arabia; salaries for unexpired contract, salary differentials and refund of withheld telephone charges upheld.
plain_id: Arsitek yang dipecat di Arab Saudi; gaji untuk sisa masa kontrak, selisih gaji, dan pengembalian potongan biaya telepon dikuatkan.

name: Tierra International Construction v. NLRC
plain_en: Construction workers abroad; NLRC added salaries for the unexpired portion of their contracts to unpaid salaries; agency petition dismissed.
plain_id: Pekerja konstruksi di luar negeri; NLRC menambahkan gaji untuk sisa masa kontrak pada gaji yang belum dibayar; permohonan agen ditolak.

name: Erectors, Inc. v. NLRC
plain_en: Overseas driver's claim for underpayment of wages, unpaid overtime and contractual bonus; whether the POEA or labor arbiter had jurisdiction.
plain_id: Tuntutan sopir di luar negeri atas kekurangan upah, lembur yang tidak dibayar, dan bonus kontrak; apakah POEA atau arbiter ketenagakerjaan yang berwenang.

name: Stolt-Nielsen Marine Services v. NLRC (1996)
plain_en: Seafarer dismissed early awarded salaries for unexpired contract; award of fixed overtime pay deleted.
plain_id: Pelaut yang diberhentikan sebelum kontrak berakhir mendapat gaji untuk sisa masa kontrak; uang lembur tetap dihapus.

name: Ranises v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarer's claim for unexpired contract salaries and salary differentials; NLRC reversal set aside in the worker's favour.
plain_id: Tuntutan pelaut atas gaji sisa masa kontrak dan selisih gaji; pembatalan oleh NLRC dikesampingkan dan pekerja dimenangkan.

name: Stolt-Nielsen Marine Services v. NLRC (1996, G.R. 105396)
plain_en: Seafarer awarded unexpired contract salaries; fixed overtime of US$2,250 deleted for lack of proof of overtime work.
plain_id: Pelaut mendapat gaji untuk sisa masa kontrak; lembur tetap sebesar 2.250 dolar AS dihapus karena kerja lembur tidak terbukti.

name: Pacific Maritime Services v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarers' claims under POEA-approved contracts for unpaid salaries, fixed overtime and leave pay; NLRC award affirmed.
plain_id: Tuntutan pelaut berdasarkan kontrak yang disetujui POEA atas gaji yang belum dibayar, lembur tetap, dan uang cuti; putusan NLRC dikuatkan.

name: EMS Manpower and Placement Services v. NLRC
plain_en: Worker in Hong Kong dismissed early; HK$55,000 salaries for unexpired contract affirmed against the agency.
plain_id: Pekerja di Hong Kong diberhentikan sebelum kontrak berakhir; gaji sisa masa kontrak sebesar 55.000 dolar Hong Kong dikuatkan terhadap agen.

name: Philippine-Singapore Transport Services v. NLRC
plain_en: Dismissed worker's claim for unpaid salary, plane fare deducted from wages, leave pay and salaries for unexpired contract.
plain_id: Tuntutan pekerja yang dipecat atas gaji yang belum dibayar, ongkos pesawat yang dipotong dari upah, uang cuti, dan gaji sisa masa kontrak.

name: Vinta Maritime v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarer dismissed without due process; award of salaries including fixed overtime for the unexpired contract affirmed.
plain_id: Pelaut dipecat tanpa proses yang layak; putusan gaji termasuk lembur tetap untuk sisa masa kontrak dikuatkan.

name: ABD Overseas Manpower v. NLRC
plain_en: Overseas worker's unexpired contract salaries and overtime claim; liability shared between two recruitment agencies.
plain_id: Tuntutan pekerja di luar negeri atas gaji sisa masa kontrak dan lembur; tanggung jawab dibagi antara dua agen perekrutan.

name: Ocean East Agency v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarer's salary, overtime, leave and benefits for unexpired contract; POEA award reinstated.
plain_id: Gaji, lembur, cuti, dan tunjangan pelaut untuk sisa masa kontrak; putusan POEA dipulihkan.

name: Singa Ship Management v. NLRC
plain_en: Cruise ship worker's complaint for wages for unexpired contract and overtime pay; agency and principal held jointly liable.
plain_id: Pengaduan pekerja kapal pesiar atas upah sisa masa kontrak dan lembur; agen dan pemberi kerja di luar negeri bertanggung jawab bersama.

name: ACCESS v. NLRC
plain_en: How to compute salaries owed for the unexpired portion of a Saudi contract (three months or full term).
plain_id: Cara menghitung gaji yang terutang untuk sisa masa kontrak di Arab Saudi (tiga bulan atau seluruh sisa masa kontrak).

name: Triple Eight Integrated Services v. NLRC
plain_en: Woman food server in Saudi Arabia; unpaid salaries, salary differential and unexpired contract salaries after illness dismissal.
plain_id: Pramusaji perempuan di Arab Saudi; gaji yang belum dibayar, selisih gaji, dan gaji sisa masa kontrak setelah dipecat karena sakit.

name: Asia World Recruitment v. NLRC
plain_en: Worker in Angola; salary differential, deductions from wages for vehicle damage and overtime pay claims.
plain_id: Pekerja di Angola; tuntutan selisih gaji, potongan upah untuk kerusakan kendaraan, dan uang lembur.

name: Marsaman Manning Agency v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarer repatriated early; salaries for the unexpired contract and attorney's fees affirmed.
plain_id: Pelaut dipulangkan sebelum kontrak berakhir; gaji sisa masa kontrak dan biaya pengacara dikuatkan.

name: Barros v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarer's claim for unexpired contract salaries, unauthorized deductions and discrimination for being Filipino; POEA decision reinstated.
plain_id: Tuntutan pelaut atas gaji sisa masa kontrak, potongan tanpa izin, dan diskriminasi karena berkebangsaan Filipina; putusan POEA dipulihkan.

name: Sameer Overseas Placement Agency v. NLRC (1999)
plain_en: Domestic helper in Taiwan dismissed without cause; NT$151,996 salaries for unexpired contract affirmed.
plain_id: Pekerja rumah tangga di Taiwan dipecat tanpa alasan; gaji sisa masa kontrak sebesar 151.996 dolar Taiwan dikuatkan.

name: Legahi v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarer's claim for unexpired contract salary, unpaid overtime, leave pay and salary differential; award limited by the Court.
plain_id: Tuntutan pelaut atas gaji sisa masa kontrak, lembur yang tidak dibayar, uang cuti, dan selisih gaji; jumlah putusan dibatasi oleh Mahkamah.

name: Skippers Pacific v. Mira
plain_en: Seafarer's complaint for illegal dismissal and unpaid salaries and allowances for the unexpired contract; award affirmed.
plain_id: Pengaduan pelaut atas pemecatan tidak sah serta gaji dan tunjangan yang belum dibayar untuk sisa masa kontrak; putusan dikuatkan.

name: OSM Shipping Philippines v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarer's unpaid salaries, accrued fixed overtime, allowance, leave pay and termination pay; NLRC award reinstated.
plain_id: Gaji pelaut yang belum dibayar, lembur tetap, tunjangan, uang cuti, dan pesangon; putusan NLRC dipulihkan.

name: De Jesus v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarer's unpaid wages applied to his repatriation cost; claim for unpaid wages, sickwage allowance and medical expenses upheld.
plain_id: Upah pelaut yang belum dibayar dipakai untuk biaya pemulangannya; tuntutan atas upah, tunjangan sakit, dan biaya pengobatan dikabulkan.

name: EDI-Staffbuilders International v. NLRC
plain_en: Which law governs an overseas contract; salaries for the unexpired portion under Republic Act 8042.
plain_id: Hukum mana yang berlaku bagi kontrak kerja di luar negeri; gaji sisa masa kontrak berdasarkan Republic Act 8042.

name: Talidano v. Falcon Maritime
plain_en: Seafarer alleging maltreatment of Filipino crew; dismissal declared illegal with salary award under RA 8042.
plain_id: Pelaut yang mengadukan perlakuan buruk terhadap awak kapal Filipina; pemecatan dinyatakan tidak sah dan gaji wajib dibayar berdasarkan RA 8042.

name: Universal Staffing Services v. NLRC
plain_en: Worker in the UAE illegally dismissed; three months' salary under RA 8042 Section 10; overtime and holiday pay denied.
plain_id: Pekerja di Uni Emirat Arab dipecat secara tidak sah; tiga bulan gaji berdasarkan Pasal 10 RA 8042; uang lembur dan uang hari libur ditolak.

name: Ventis Maritime v. Court of Appeals
plain_en: Ship officer's unpaid salary and accrued benefits and guaranteed overtime; Court of Appeals set aside.
plain_id: Gaji dan tunjangan perwira kapal yang belum dibayar serta lembur yang dijamin; putusan Pengadilan Banding dibatalkan.

name: NFD International Manning Agents v. NLRC
plain_en: Crew repatriated early; unpaid wages and salaries for the unexpired portion with damages affirmed.
plain_id: Awak kapal dipulangkan sebelum kontrak berakhir; upah yang belum dibayar dan gaji sisa masa kontrak beserta ganti rugi dikuatkan.

name: Hanjin Heavy Industries v. Court of Appeals
plain_en: Construction worker abroad awarded salaries for the entire unexpired portion of his contract.
plain_id: Pekerja konstruksi di luar negeri mendapat gaji untuk seluruh sisa masa kontraknya.

name: Centro Project Manpower Services v. Naluis
plain_en: Dismissed worker gets placement fee refund and unexpired contract salaries; guaranteed overtime and holiday pay deleted.
plain_id: Pekerja yang dipecat mendapat pengembalian biaya penempatan dan gaji sisa masa kontrak; lembur dan uang hari libur yang dijamin dihapus.

name: Eagle Clarc Shipping Philippines v. NLRC
plain_en: Seafarer's claim for unexpired contract salary, fixed overtime and benefits; award affirmed with changes.
plain_id: Tuntutan pelaut atas gaji sisa masa kontrak, lembur tetap, dan tunjangan; putusan dikuatkan dengan perubahan.

name: Jerzon Manpower and Trading v. Nato
plain_en: Worker in Taiwan awarded three months' unpaid salaries under RA 8042 Section 10; financial assistance award changed.
plain_id: Pekerja di Taiwan mendapat tiga bulan gaji yang belum dibayar berdasarkan Pasal 10 RA 8042; putusan bantuan keuangan diubah.

name: Canon Garcia v. Ecuador
plain_en: Ecuadorian national handed over to United States agents without an extradition procedure; Committee looked at removal without due process.
plain_id: Warga Ekuador diserahkan kepada aparat Amerika Serikat tanpa prosedur ekstradisi; Komite meninjau pengusiran tanpa proses hukum yang layak.

name: El Dernawi v. Libya
plain_en: Libya confiscated the passport of a man living abroad, keeping his family from leaving to join him; freedom to leave and family life.
plain_id: Libya menyita paspor seorang pria yang tinggal di luar negeri sehingga keluarganya tidak bisa pergi menyusulnya; kebebasan meninggalkan negara dan hak atas kehidupan keluarga.

name: Valetov v. Kazakhstan
plain_en: Kazakhstan extradited a Kyrgyz national to Kyrgyzstan despite a risk of torture; non-refoulement.
plain_id: Kazakhstan mengekstradisi warga Kirgizstan ke Kirgizstan meski ada risiko penyiksaan; larangan pemulangan paksa (non-refoulement).

name: Kwami Mopongo and others v. Morocco
plain_en: Migrants from Central Africa expelled by Morocco to the Algerian desert border; non-refoulement and collective expulsion.
plain_id: Migran dari Afrika Tengah diusir oleh Maroko ke perbatasan gurun Aljazair; larangan pemulangan paksa dan pengusiran massal.

name: Rouba Alhaj Ali v. Morocco
plain_en: Morocco ordered the extradition of a woman to Saudi Arabia; risk of torture on return.
plain_id: Maroko memerintahkan ekstradisi seorang perempuan ke Arab Saudi; risiko penyiksaan setelah dipulangkan.

name: Naouel Gharsallah v. Morocco
plain_en: Extradition from Morocco to Tunisia; risk of torture.
plain_id: Ekstradisi dari Maroko ke Tunisia; risiko penyiksaan.

name: Maalem et al. v. Uzbekistan
plain_en: Uzbekistan and the expulsion of foreign nationals; non-refoulement (check facts).
plain_id: Uzbekistan dan pengusiran warga negara asing; larangan pemulangan paksa (fakta perlu dicek).

name: Ferhat Erdogan v. Morocco
plain_en: Morocco extraditing a Turkish national to Turkey; risk of torture.
plain_id: Maroko mengekstradisi warga Turki ke Turki; risiko penyiksaan.

name: Mustafa Onder v. Morocco
plain_en: Morocco extraditing a Turkish national to Turkey; risk of torture.
plain_id: Maroko mengekstradisi warga Turki ke Turki; risiko penyiksaan.

name: Elmas Ayden v. Morocco
plain_en: Morocco extraditing a Turkish national to Turkey; risk of torture.
plain_id: Maroko mengekstradisi warga Turki ke Turki; risiko penyiksaan.

name: Hany Khater v. Morocco
plain_en: Extradition from Morocco to Egypt; risk of torture.
plain_id: Ekstradisi dari Maroko ke Mesir; risiko penyiksaan.

name: Ismet Bakay v. Morocco
plain_en: Removal of a Turkish national from Morocco; non-refoulement.
plain_id: Pengusiran warga Turki dari Maroko; larangan pemulangan paksa.

name: A.G. et al. v. Angola
citation: A.G. et al. v. Angola (communication number to be added)
plain_en: Angola and the removal of foreign nationals; non-refoulement (check facts).
plain_id: Angola dan pengusiran warga negara asing; larangan pemulangan paksa (fakta perlu dicek).

name: A and B v. Azerbaijan
plain_en: Azerbaijan returning two persons to a state where they faced a risk of torture; non-refoulement (check facts).
plain_id: Azerbaijan memulangkan dua orang ke negara tempat mereka berisiko disiksa; larangan pemulangan paksa (fakta perlu dicek).

name: Laaroussi v. Morocco
plain_en: Morocco and the removal of a person facing torture abroad; non-refoulement (check facts).
plain_id: Maroko dan pengusiran seseorang yang berisiko disiksa di luar negeri; larangan pemulangan paksa (fakta perlu dicek).

name: Samuel Mukira Mohochi v. The Attorney General of the Republic of Uganda
court: East African Court of Justice (First Instance Division)
plain_en: Kenyan advocate denied entry to Uganda, detained and sent back; denial of entry to a citizen of a Partner State without due process breached the EAC Treaty (Arts 6(d), 7(2), 104) and Art. 7 of the Common Market Protocol; s.52 of the Citizenship and Immigration Control Act inoperative for EAC citizens.
plain_id: Advokat Kenya ditolak masuk ke Uganda, ditahan, lalu dipulangkan; penolakan masuk terhadap warga negara anggota Komunitas Afrika Timur tanpa proses yang layak melanggar Traktat EAC dan Protokol Pasar Bersama; Pasal 52 Undang-Undang Kewarganegaraan dan Pengawasan Imigrasi Uganda tidak berlaku bagi warga EAC.

name: Issack Katelo v Republic
plain_en: Imprisonment not mandatory under the Immigration Act; a fine may be imposed.
plain_id: Hukuman penjara tidak wajib berdasarkan Undang-Undang Imigrasi; denda bisa dijatuhkan.

name: Mijafar Ahmed Arat v Republic
plain_en: Immigration Act s 30: person whose citizenship or lawful presence is contested bears the burden of proof.
plain_id: Undang-Undang Imigrasi Pasal 30: orang yang kewarganegaraan atau keberadaannya yang sah dipersoalkan memikul beban pembuktian.

name: In re Abdulkarim Abdala Miliongita Bailanya v Commissioner General of Immigration and Another
citation: Misc Criminal Application No. 156 of 2016; [2017] TZHC 3006
plain_en: Habeas corpus refused: detention under ministerial deportation and detention orders lawful.
plain_id: Habeas corpus ditolak: penahanan berdasarkan perintah deportasi dan penahanan dari menteri dinyatakan sah.

name: Nasser Rashid Nasser v Minister of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Ministerial detention and deportation order upheld; Zanzibar court order did not nullify it.
plain_id: Perintah penahanan dan deportasi dari menteri dikuatkan; putusan pengadilan Zanzibar tidak membatalkannya.

name: Paul Norberth Mwamkongwa v Republic
plain_en: Duplicitous charge combining Immigration Act offences invalidated the conviction.
plain_id: Dakwaan ganda yang menggabungkan beberapa tindak pidana imigrasi membatalkan vonis.

name: Siegfried Hofman v Republic
citation: High Court Criminal Appeal No. 51 of 1989; [1990] TZHC 405
plain_en: Immigration Act conviction upheld; regional permission no defence.
plain_id: Vonis berdasarkan Undang-Undang Imigrasi dikuatkan; izin dari pemerintah daerah bukan pembelaan.

name: Adamas Conglomerate Limited v Cihat Demir
plain_en: Civil suit over breach of work and residence permits remitted for a hearing on the merits.
plain_id: Gugatan perdata atas pelanggaran izin kerja dan izin tinggal dikembalikan untuk diperiksa pokok perkaranya.

name: Alice Nyawira alias Ndungu v Republic
plain_en: Foreign first offender: fine plus immediate imprisonment improper; release ordered.
plain_id: Pelanggar pertama berkewarganegaraan asing: denda ditambah penjara langsung tidak tepat; pembebasan diperintahkan.

name: Mayko Jaes Namlowe
citation: Misc Criminal Application No 123 of 2023; [2023] TZHC 21231
plain_en: Habeas corpus against refusal of entry and detention pending removal dismissed.
plain_id: Habeas corpus terhadap penolakan masuk dan penahanan sambil menunggu pemulangan ditolak.

name: Hatungimana Odasi and Another v Republic
plain_en: Sentence reduced and deportation ordered for indigent first-time foreign offenders (unlawful presence).
plain_id: Hukuman dikurangi dan deportasi diperintahkan bagi pelanggar pertama berkewarganegaraan asing yang miskin (keberadaan tanpa izin).

name: Geoffrey s/o Wamala v Republic
citation: Miscellaneous Criminal Application No. 116 of 2000; [2000] TZHC 534
plain_en: Lawful presence not proved; forged identity document.
plain_id: Keberadaan yang sah tidak terbukti; dokumen identitas palsu.

name: Director of Public Prosecutions v Andrea Kalongozi Ondieki
plain_en: Immigration Act s 30: onus on person claiming citizenship or lawful presence.
plain_id: Undang-Undang Imigrasi Pasal 30: beban pembuktian ada pada orang yang mengaku warga negara atau berada secara sah.

name: Renard Seba and Another v Republic
plain_en: Excessive sentence for unlawful presence reduced; release and deportation.
plain_id: Hukuman yang berlebihan atas keberadaan tanpa izin dikurangi; pembebasan dan deportasi.

name: Niyongere Nestory v Republic
plain_en: Sentence for unlawful presence reduced; release and deportation.
plain_id: Hukuman atas keberadaan tanpa izin dikurangi; pembebasan dan deportasi.

name: Mpawenimana Izaki and Another v Republic
plain_en: Custodial sentence reduced where fine could not be paid; deportation ordered.
plain_id: Hukuman penjara dikurangi karena denda tidak mampu dibayar; deportasi diperintahkan.

name: Said Daniel Mzava v Republic
plain_en: Conviction for harbouring irregular migrants quashed: status and knowledge not proved.
plain_id: Vonis atas penyembunyian migran tanpa dokumen dibatalkan: status migran dan pengetahuan terdakwa tidak terbukti.

name: Saimon s/o Odour Otieno v Republic
citation: DC Criminal Appeal No. 64 of 2007; [2008] TZHC 305
plain_en: No prima facie case; repatriation order unlawful.
plain_id: Tidak ada bukti awal yang cukup; perintah pemulangan tidak sah.

name: Yusufu Ahmedi v Republic
citation: High Court Criminal Appeal No. 311 of 1977; [1978] TZHC 169
plain_en: Immigration offences of absolute liability; acquittal where forgery not proved.
plain_id: Tindak pidana imigrasi bersifat tanggung jawab mutlak; terdakwa dibebaskan karena pemalsuan tidak terbukti.

name: Josephine Wegesa Mkono v Principal Commissioner for Immigration Services
citation: Miscellaneous Civil Cause No. 09 of 2011; [2011] TZHC 2285
plain_en: Deportation notice acted on without ministerial confirmation is incomplete and reviewable.
plain_id: Pemberitahuan deportasi yang dijalankan tanpa pengesahan menteri belum lengkap dan bisa diuji.

name: Richard Nkomo v Hodi (Hotel Management) Co. Ltd t/a Mount Meru Hotel
plain_en: Foreign employee: rescission for lack of a valid residence permit lawful.
plain_id: Pekerja asing: pemutusan kontrak karena tidak memiliki izin tinggal yang sah dinyatakan sah.

name: Richard Nkomo v Hodi (Hotel Management) Co. Ltd t/a Mount Meru Hotel
plain_en: Court of Appeal upholds rescission of a foreign worker's contract for lack of a residence permit.
plain_id: Pengadilan Banding menguatkan pemutusan kontrak pekerja asing karena tidak memiliki izin tinggal.

name: Adaeze Kelley Okeh v Project Rose Global
plain_en: Foreign worker's claim fails for lack of a work permit.
plain_id: Tuntutan pekerja asing gagal karena tidak memiliki izin kerja.

name: Coastal Travel Ltd v Offing Russel Ekerete
plain_en: Employment contract made after work-permit expiry illegal and unenforceable.
plain_id: Kontrak kerja yang dibuat setelah izin kerja habis berlaku tidak sah dan tidak bisa ditegakkan.

name: Edith Nababi v Kemobos English Medium Boarding Primary School
plain_en: Labour commission lacks jurisdiction where the foreign employee had no valid work permit.
plain_id: Komisi ketenagakerjaan tidak berwenang karena pekerja asing tidak memiliki izin kerja yang sah.

name: Curechem Tanzania (Pvt) Ltd v Hamandishe Matsekwa
citation: Consolidated Labour Revision No. 27 of 2022; [2023] TZHC 15875
plain_en: No jurisdiction where the foreign employee had no work permit.
plain_id: Tidak berwenang karena pekerja asing tidak memiliki izin kerja.

name: Zorica Vejapi v Wilderness Trail-Karama Lodge
plain_en: Contract signed before work and residence permits issued is ineffective; no compensation.
plain_id: Kontrak yang ditandatangani sebelum izin kerja dan izin tinggal terbit tidak berlaku; tanpa ganti rugi.

name: Bevco Limited v Melanie Philippe
plain_en: Whether an expired work permit invalidates employment.
plain_id: Apakah izin kerja yang habis berlaku membatalkan hubungan kerja.

name: Robenson Munene Gakono v African Plantation Kilimanjaro Ltd
plain_en: Foreign plantation worker: contract void for expired work permit; no repatriation payable.
plain_id: Pekerja perkebunan asing: kontrak batal karena izin kerja habis berlaku; biaya pemulangan tidak wajib dibayar.

name: Kassimu Daudi Kassimu Walata v Republic
plain_en: Bail refused: trafficking in persons is non-bailable.
plain_id: Penangguhan penahanan ditolak: perdagangan orang tidak bisa ditangguhkan penahanannya.

name: Winnie Cessy Soka v Attorney General and Another
citation: Misc. Civil Application No. 23 of 2013; [2013] TZHC 2469
plain_en: Spouse lacks standing to challenge a prohibited immigrant notice issued to her husband.
plain_id: Istri tidak memiliki kedudukan hukum untuk menggugat pemberitahuan imigran terlarang yang diberikan kepada suaminya.

name: Siegfried Milchberger v Director of Immigration Service
citation: Misc. Civil Cause No. 85 of 1988; [1988] TZHC 247
plain_en: Notice to Prohibited Immigrant cannot be stayed by injunction.
plain_id: Pemberitahuan Imigran Terlarang tidak bisa ditunda melalui putusan sela.

name: Republic v Mohanlal Babool Walji
citation: High Court Criminal Appeal No. 43 of 1973; [1973] TZHC 196
plain_en: Defective immigration notice cannot be challenged on appeal after a guilty plea.
plain_id: Pemberitahuan imigrasi yang cacat tidak bisa digugat di tingkat banding setelah terdakwa mengaku bersalah.

name: Mandiki Bin Luyeye v Director of Immigration Services and Others
citation: Miscellaneous Civil Application No. 10 of 2004; [2008] TZHC 502
plain_en: Leave for judicial review of an immigration decision refused (hearsay affidavit).
plain_id: Izin untuk uji yudisial atas keputusan imigrasi ditolak (afidavit berisi keterangan dari orang lain).

name: Lucien Ikili Rashid v Mussa Ruganda Leki and 3 Others
plain_en: Non-national without immigration documents cannot claim false imprisonment for lawful arrest.
plain_id: Warga negara asing tanpa dokumen imigrasi tidak bisa menuntut ganti rugi atas penangkapan yang sah.

name: Peter Erick Mrina v Attorney General and 2 Others
citation: Misc Criminal Application No. 134 of 2022; [2023] TZHC 19394
plain_en: Mandamus to enforce deportation struck out (no leave for judicial review).
plain_id: Permohonan mandamus untuk memaksa pelaksanaan deportasi dicoret (tanpa izin uji yudisial).

name: Tarlochan Singh v Republic
plain_en: Fines for overstaying not manifestly excessive.
plain_id: Denda karena tinggal melewati batas izin tidak terlalu berat.

name: Patel v Attorney General
plain_en: Bail for a detainee held under the Immigration and Deportation Act.
plain_id: Penangguhan penahanan bagi tahanan berdasarkan Undang-Undang Imigrasi dan Deportasi.

name: Charles Mukinkila Chitengi v Attorney General
plain_en: Whether the appellant was a citizen and so immune from deportation (s 26(2)).
plain_id: Apakah pemohon banding adalah warga negara sehingga kebal dari deportasi (Pasal 26(2)).

name: In Re Chirwa
plain_en: Minister cannot use immigration powers to deport a person recognised as a refugee.
plain_id: Menteri tidak bisa memakai kewenangan imigrasi untuk mendeportasi orang yang diakui sebagai pengungsi.

name: Mifiboshe Walulya v Attorney General
plain_en: Immigration detention: Article 15 notice, not Article 27 written grounds.
plain_id: Penahanan imigrasi: pemberitahuan berdasarkan Pasal 15, bukan alasan tertulis berdasarkan Pasal 27.

name: Buchman v Attorney General
plain_en: Extension of stay; recusal not raised below.
plain_id: Perpanjangan izin tinggal; permohonan agar hakim mundur tidak diajukan di tingkat sebelumnya.

name: Omar Dirie Hirsi v Attorney General
plain_en: Interim permission for a deported person to attend judicial review (fair hearing).
plain_id: Izin sementara bagi orang yang dideportasi untuk menghadiri uji yudisial (hak atas pemeriksaan yang adil).

name: Chitengi v Attorney General
plain_en: Disputed nationality; evidence of registration; deportation upheld.
plain_id: Kewarganegaraan yang dipersoalkan; bukti pendaftaran; deportasi dikuatkan.

name: Kibler v Apollo Agricultural Holdings Limited
plain_en: Foreign employee of a farm company; injunction to stay in employer housing refused.
plain_id: Pekerja asing di perusahaan pertanian; putusan sela agar tetap tinggal di perumahan pemberi kerja ditolak.

name: Vekhnik v Casa Dei Bambini Montessori Zambia Ltd
plain_en: Foreign employee: wrongful dismissal; statutory duty to repatriate despite contract.
plain_id: Pekerja asing: pemecatan tidak sah; kewajiban hukum untuk memulangkan pekerja meskipun kontrak berkata lain.

name: Apollo Agriculture Holdings Limited v Herman Josef Kibler
plain_en: Foreign farm-company employee: repatriation duty met by providing a ticket.
plain_id: Pekerja asing di perusahaan pertanian: kewajiban pemulangan terpenuhi dengan menyediakan tiket.

name: Cheng You v Attorney General
plain_en: Revocation of a temporary permit for breach of investment-certificate conditions.
plain_id: Pencabutan izin sementara karena melanggar syarat sertifikat investasi.

name: Chanty Mupoyi Kalanga v The Attorney General
plain_en: Leave for judicial review of a deportation order (no chance to make representations).
plain_id: Izin uji yudisial atas perintah deportasi (tanpa kesempatan menyampaikan keberatan).

name: Mufaya Mumbuna v The People
plain_en: Immigration detainee entitled to oral reasons (Article 15(2)).
plain_id: Tahanan imigrasi berhak atas alasan penahanan secara lisan (Pasal 15(2)).

name: Paton v Attorney General and Ors
plain_en: Unlawful deportation and false imprisonment: compensatory and exemplary damages.
plain_id: Deportasi tidak sah dan penahanan tanpa dasar hukum: ganti rugi kompensasi dan ganti rugi penghukuman.

name: Chief Immigration Officer v Minister of Home Affairs and Another
plain_en: Extension of temporary residence is discretionary; no right to indefinite stay.
plain_id: Perpanjangan izin tinggal sementara bersifat diskresi; tidak ada hak untuk tinggal tanpa batas waktu.

name: Director of Public Prosecutions v Brown
plain_en: Offence of working without a permit; sentencing of first offenders.
plain_id: Tindak pidana bekerja tanpa izin; pemidanaan bagi pelanggar pertama.

name: Kalyoto Muhalyo Paluku v Grannys Bakery Limited and Ors
plain_en: Non-citizen entry-permit holder cannot own land without Presidential consent.
plain_id: Pemegang izin masuk yang bukan warga negara tidak bisa memiliki tanah tanpa persetujuan Presiden.

name: Mundungani v Chief Immigration Officer and Others
plain_en: Deportation warrant quashed: citizenship by descent proved; procedural safeguards.
plain_id: Surat perintah deportasi dibatalkan: kewarganegaraan berdasarkan keturunan terbukti; jaminan prosedural.

name: M.I Projects Ltd v Van Der Merwe
plain_en: Employment contract without a work permit is not automatically unenforceable.
plain_id: Kontrak kerja tanpa izin kerja tidak otomatis tidak bisa ditegakkan.

name: Matthew Francis Watkins and Anor v The Attorney General
plain_en: Refusal of employment and spouse permits under Zambianisation policy upheld.
plain_id: Penolakan izin kerja dan izin bagi pasangan berdasarkan kebijakan Zambianisasi dikuatkan.

name: The People v Director General of Immigration and Another
plain_en: Persons declared prohibited immigrants entitled to temporary permits pending judicial review.
plain_id: Orang yang ditetapkan sebagai imigran terlarang berhak atas izin sementara selama uji yudisial berlangsung.

name: Attorney General v Ali Abdulwahid
plain_en: Deportation without a warrant or disclosed grounds breached natural justice.
plain_id: Deportasi tanpa surat perintah atau alasan yang diungkapkan melanggar prinsip keadilan alamiah.

name: Folayinka Fobisaiye Oladipo Esan v The Attorney General
plain_en: Deportation unlawful: employment-permit revocation without written notice and statutory procedure.
plain_id: Deportasi tidak sah: izin kerja dicabut tanpa pemberitahuan tertulis dan tanpa prosedur menurut undang-undang.

name: Jean Kanyamuneza v The Attorney General
plain_en: Detention pending expulsion without statutory notice: habeas corpus and release.
plain_id: Penahanan sambil menunggu pengusiran tanpa pemberitahuan menurut undang-undang: habeas corpus dan pembebasan.

name: Mulumbilwa and Ors v People
plain_en: Trafficking convictions set aside: means and exploitative purpose not proved.
plain_id: Vonis perdagangan orang dibatalkan: cara dan tujuan eksploitasi tidak terbukti.

name: Baby Nzali v Pick n Pay Zambia Limited
plain_en: Expatriate employee: unfair termination on speculative permit-renewal ground.
plain_id: Pekerja ekspatriat: pemutusan hubungan kerja tidak adil dengan alasan spekulatif soal perpanjangan izin.

name: Thiroshin Pillai v Pick and Pay Zambia Limited
plain_en: Expatriate employee unlawfully terminated without reasons; 12 months' pay.
